_comment_3: Source: Bright MLS NJBL2118914 (Matrix agent full report, 08/18/2026).
description: A four-bedroom colonial in Cambridge Estates, on a fully fenced quarter-acre lot. The two-story foyer opens to a vaulted living room lit by an arched transom window, with a formal dining room alongside. The family room sits under a vaulted ceiling with two skylights and a gas fireplace flanked by floor-to-ceiling windows, and sliding doors out to the paver patio. The kitchen has an island, a breakfast area, and a bay window over the counter. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a bay-window sitting area, a walk-in closet, and a renovated bath with a double vanity, skylights, and a tiled walk-in shower with a bench. Three additional bedrooms share a hall bath. Laundry is on the main floor. The roof was replaced in 2022 and the water heater in 2026. Natural gas forced-air heat, central air, and a two-car attached garage with inside access, in the Lenape Regional High School District.
